# uptimekuma_notification_onebot (Resource)

OneBot notification resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uptimekuma_notification_onebot" "group_message" {
  name         = "OneBot Group Notification"
  http_addr    = "http://localhost:5700"
  access_token = "your-access-token"
  msg_type     = "group"
  receiver_id  = "123456789"
  is_default   = false
}

resource "uptimekuma_notification_onebot" "private_message" {
  name         = "OneBot Private Notification"
  http_addr    = "http://localhost:5700"
  access_token = "your-access-token"
  msg_type     = "private"
  receiver_id  = "987654321"
  is_default   = false
}

# Requires Terraform or OpenTofu 1.11 or later: access_token_wo is never stored in
# plan or state. Change the matching *_wo_version whenever a secret changes.
resource "uptimekuma_notification_onebot" "write_only" {
  name        = "OneBot with write-only secret"
  http_addr   = "http://localhost:5700"
  msg_type    = "group"
  receiver_id = "123456789"

  access_token_wo         = "your-access-token"
  access_token_wo_version = "1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `http_addr` (String) HTTP address of the OneBot service (e.g., `http://localhost:5700`).
- `msg_type` (String) Message type: `group` for group messages or `private` for private messages.
- `name` (String) Notification name
- `receiver_id` (String) QQ group ID (when `msg_type` is `group`) or user ID (when `msg_type` is `private`).

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `access_token` (String, Sensitive) Access token for authentication with the OneBot service. Stored in state; use `access_token_wo` to keep it out of state.
- `access_token_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Access token for authentication with the OneBot service, write-only: sent to Uptime Kuma on create and update but never stored in plan or state. Requires Terraform 1.11 or OpenTofu 1.11 or later. Conflicts with `access_token`; requires `access_token_wo_version`. An imported resource has no `access_token_wo_version` yet, so `terraform import` may store the server's value in `access_token` until the next apply with `access_token_wo` set removes it from state.
- `access_token_wo_version` (String) Any value that changes whenever `access_token_wo` changes, for example a counter or a hash of the secret's encrypted source. A change triggers an update that sends the current `access_token_wo`.
- `apply_existing` (Boolean)
- `is_default` (Boolean)

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Notification identifier
